rules.statement: This Court has the power to correct an accidental slip or omission in a judgment under Section 189 of the Civil Procedure Code, even if it involves granting relief that was not originally requested by the parties.
rules.supporting_quote: "When an error of that kind has been committed, it is always within the competency of the Court, if nothing has intervened which renders it inexpedient or inequitable to do so, to correct the record in order to bring it into harmony with the, order which the Judge obviously meant to pronounce."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 189 of the Civil Procedure Code

meta.parties: Thambipillai Et Al. v. Muthucumaraswamy Et Al
